socialSampleLimitation: Bounded historical AppView search capture; cursor pagination is unavailable and archive completeness cannot be proven.

common.socialDeduplication: Within each asset, retain the earliest availability for a text SHA-256 and suppress repeats for 24 hours.
common.authorCap: At most three retained messages per author, asset, and UTC hour.
common.marketBars: Complete Binance USDT-M 15-minute bars only; never interpolate gaps.
common.assetEffects: Pooled OLS includes fixed symbol indicators with BTC omitted.
common.development: Four chronological 14-day expanding folds; no tuning.
common.holdout: Fit once on training plus development, then forecast the common sealed 60-day interval.
common.inference: First average loss differentials cross-sectionally by decision time, then use a two-sided normal approximation from Newey-West HAC standard errors; lag 96 for 15-minute buckets, 24 for hourly buckets, and 7 for daily buckets.
common.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the four candidate-versus-primary-control holdout p-values.

retrospective-single-source-social-atten.feature: Prior completed UTC-hour message count standardized by the preceding 720 completed hourly counts.
retrospective-single-source-social-atten.target: Log next-hour realized variance from four complete 15-minute bars.
retrospective-single-source-social-atten.primaryMetric: QLIKE after exponentiating the log-variance forecast

retrospective-single-source-social-disag.feature: Sample standard deviation of polarity among retained messages in the prior completed UTC hour; requires at least two messages.
retrospective-single-source-social-disag.target: Log next-hour realized variance from four complete 15-minute bars.
retrospective-single-source-social-disag.primaryMetric: QLIKE after exponentiating the log-variance forecast

retrospective-single-source-social-polar.feature: Mean polarity among retained messages in the prior completed 15-minute bucket; requires at least one message.

retrospective-cross-sectional-social-att.feature: Prior completed UTC-day message count standardized by the preceding 30 completed daily counts, then cross-sectionally ranked from zero to one.
retrospective-cross-sectional-social-att.portfolioDiagnostic: Equal-weight top three minus bottom three gross next-day return; execution costs unavailable.
